risk_summary: The excerpt combines detailed quantitative performance data with extensive legal disclaimers and estimates surrounding loan-loss allowances, interest recognition, and servicing-right valuations. Earnings declined year over year, but management presents asset quality, recoveries, loan growth, and net interest margin as favorable, producing a mildly positive overall risk tone. Key risks include acquisition-related costs, changing economic conditions, borrower losses, and sensitivity to valuation and prepayment assumptions.
